race.description: Big Dance Day On 3 November Mdn Hcp
race.comment: FORCE MARCH (1) lightly raced gelding who returned for his second campaign with an eye-catching second when lugging the 59kg over 1150m at Beaumont (Newcastle). Back in good order and ready to get off the mark. MAYSUN (6) resumed with a tough on-pace second over 1200m at Bathurst on the heavy (9) track. Blinkers go on and looks to have top three claims. CREDIBILITY (2) improving with racing third up and finds a suitable contest today. Turned in a better effort last time when fourth over 1250m at Beaumont (Newcastle). Can get cover from the gate and play a leading role. RED PLANET BAR (3) resumes. Chipped away late on debut in the heavy going when third over 1300m at Newcastle on June 27. Given the two trials and look for him doing his best work late.
